====== NCORE_TB.V: INSTRUCTION SET & CPU CONTROL ANALYSIS ======

--- INSTRUCTION OPCODES ---
 0 = ADD   | 1 = SUB | 2 = AND | 3 = OR | 4 = RES
 5 = MOVF  | 6 = MOVT| 7 = ENT | 8 = EXT
 9 = JGT   | 10= JEQ | 11= JMP
12 = INC   |13 = MOVFS

--- INSTRUCTION FORMAT ---
Each instruction is 2 bytes (ram[pc], ram[pc+1]):
- ram[pc][3:0]: opcode (lower 4 bits of 1st byte)
- ram[pc][5:4] and ram[pc][7:6]: source/dest register encodings within 1st byte
- ram[pc+1]: memory/register index (8 bits)

Instruction encodings (from always @posedge clk):

* ADD: regfile[ram[pc][5:4]] <- regfile[ram[pc][7:6]] + regfile[ram[pc+1][1:0]]
* INC: regfile[ram[pc][5:4]] <- regfile[ram[pc][5:4]] + 1
* SUB: regfile[ram[pc][5:4]] <- regfile[ram[pc][7:6]] - regfile[ram[pc+1][1:0]]
* MOVF: regfile[ram[pc][5:4]] <- ram[ram[pc+1]]
* MOVFS: if(emode) regfile[ram[pc][5:4]] <- safe_rom[ram[pc+1]]
* MOVT: ram[ram[pc+1]] <- regfile[ram[pc][5:4]][7:0] (low byte of reg)
* JGT: pc <- ram[pc+1] if regfile[ram[pc][5:4]] > regfile[ram[pc][7:6]] else pc+2
* JEQ: pc <- ram[pc+1] if regfile[ram[pc][5:4]] == regfile[ram[pc][7:6]] else pc+2
* JMP: pc <- ram[pc+1]
* ENT: if regfile[0] == key[0][13:0]: emode <- 1, regfile[3] <- 0; else regfile[3] <- 1; (pc += 2)
* EXT: emode <- 0; (pc += 2)
* default: pc += 2
